title: Deserializer：基于AST与LLM的Python反序列化漏洞静态分析工具
summary: 结合AST静态分析与Agentic LLM关系映射，发现Python RCE路径和深层反序列化链，面向AI、LLM、机器人、数据科学等领域的0-day漏洞挖掘。
summary_en: AST-based static code analyzer with agentic LLM-powered relationship mapping to discover Python RCE paths and deep deserialization chains across AI, LLM, robotics, and data science domains.
